convert_to_gguf: convert a HuggingFace model folder to GGUF format using llama.cpp's converter script
quantize_gguf: quantize an existing GGUF file to a lower precision like Q8_0 using llama-quantize
install_llama_cpp: clone and build llama.cpp from source with optional GPU support on Linux or Windows
check_llama_cpp: check if llama.cpp is installed and locate the quantizer and converter binaries
use_local_gguf: use llama.cpp's bundled gguf-py module temporarily via a context manager to avoid conflicts
